exceptions.title: A security group rule should not allow unrestricted egress to any IP address.
exceptions.reason: Staging explicit owner risk acceptance on 2026-10-22 for api_https TCP 443 to 0.0.0.0/0 from the private EC2 application host through the NAT egress architecture for required external HTTPS services.

exceptions.title: A security group rule should not allow unrestricted egress to any IP address.
exceptions.reason: Production explicit owner risk acceptance on 2026-10-22 for api_https TCP 443 to 0.0.0.0/0 from the private EC2 application host through the NAT egress architecture for required external HTTPS services.

exceptions.title: Load balancer is exposed to the internet.
exceptions.reason: Staging explicit owner risk acceptance on 2026-10-22: this ALB is internet-facing because staging.piqsavi.com, owner browsers, email links, and Shopify profile fetch require public reachability. API EC2 stays private, ingress is ALB-SG-only, and HTTPS requires a certificate.

exceptions.title: Load balancer is exposed to the internet.
exceptions.reason: Production explicit owner risk acceptance on 2026-10-22: this ALB is internet-facing for the controlled public beta. API EC2 stays private, ingress is ALB-SG-only, HTTPS requires a certificate, and port 80 does not forward application traffic.

exceptions.title: S3 encryption should use Customer Managed Keys
exceptions.reason: This production bucket is the ALB access-log destination and uses SSE-S3. AWS documents SSE-S3 as the only supported encryption for Application Load Balancer access logs, so a customer-managed KMS key is unsupported.

exceptions.title: S3 encryption should use Customer Managed Keys
exceptions.reason: Staging explicit owner risk acceptance on 2026-10-22 to retain SSE-S3 on the release-artifacts bucket for this beta. It stores deploy bundles and evidence, not Terraform state or application secrets, blocks public access, versions objects, and requires TLS.

exceptions.title: S3 encryption should use Customer Managed Keys
exceptions.reason: Production explicit owner risk acceptance on 2026-10-22 to retain SSE-S3 on the release-artifacts bucket for this beta. Bundles and evidence only, no Terraform state or application secrets. Public access is blocked. There is no customer-managed key policy or separate KMS audit.
